s: puM, (hve + BAve kvip । devAnAM hUrAhvAnamaneneti .) vAmakarRaH । yaTA, “ApaRo vyavahAro'tra citramanDo bahUdanam । pitfhUrdakziRaH karRa uttaro devahUH smftaH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate । 4 । 29 । 12 ॥ (tri, devAnAhvayatIti । hve + karttari kvip । devAnAM AhvAtA । yaTA, vAjasaneyasaMhitAyAm । 17 । 62 । “devahUryajYa A ca vakzatsumrahUryajYa A ca vakzat ॥”)
v: strI devAhvayante'tra hve--sampa॰ BAve kvip, karttari vA kvip । 1 devAhvAne “devahUryaja A ca vakzat” yaju॰ 18 । 62 । 2 devAhvAnakarttari tri॰ “yakzmA hi devahUtamA~ aSvA~ agne raTIriva” f॰ 8 । 4 । 1 । 4 3 yajYArTe vrIhipUrRe Sakawe ca “papritamaM juzwatamaM devahUtamam” yaju॰ 1 । 8 devAnAmatiSayenAhvAtf yajYArTaM brIhipUrRaM SakawaM dfzwvA devA AhUtA iva SIGramAgacCanti” vedadI॰ । 4 vAmakarRe “ApaRo vyavahAro'tra citramanDI bahUdanam । pivfhUrdakziRaH karRaH uttaro devahUH smftaH” BAga॰ 4 । 29 । 13 । 5 fziBede tataH gargA॰ yaY । dEvahavya tadapatye puMstrI॰
m: देव—हू mfn. invoking the g˚ (superl. -तम), RV.; VS.
देव—हू m. N. of a man g. गर्गादि
देव—हू f. (scil. द्वार्) N. of the northern aperture of the human body, i.e. of the left ear (which is turned north wards if the face is directed towards the east), BhP. iv, 25, 51 &c. (cf. पितृ-).

v: strI svAyamBu vamanormaDyamAyAM kanyAyAm “yastu tatra pumAn so'BUnmanuH svAyamBuvaH svarAw । strIyAsIt SatarUpAKyA mahizyasya mahAtmanaH । tadA BiTuna DarmeRa prajA hyeDAMbaBUvire । sa cApi SatarUpAyAM paYcApatyAnyajIjanat । priyavratottAnapAdO tisraH kanyASca BArata! । AkUtirdevahUtiSca prasUtiriti sattama! । AkUtiM rucaye prAdAt karwamAya tu maDyamAm” BAga॰ 3 । 12 । 38 sA ca kapilarUpasya BagavatImAtA yaTAha tatrEva “jajYe ca kardamagfhe dvija! devahUtyAM strIBiH samaM navaBirAtmagatiM svamAtre । Uce yamAtmaSamalaM guRasaNga paNkamasmin viDUya kapilasya gatiM prapede” BAga॰ 2 । 3 । 4 tadupadeSaprakAraSca kapilaSabde BAgavatavAkyoktaH 1663 pfzWAdO darSitaH ।
m: देव—हूति (˚व-), f. invocation of the gods, RV.; AV. &c. (also ˚ती, BhP. ix, 24, 31)
N. of a daughter of Manu Svayam-bhū and wife of Kardama, BhP. ii, 7, 3 &c. (˚ती, iii, 21, 3).

v: pu॰ devA hUyante'surEH yatra ADAre bA॰ kyap । 1 devAsurasaMgrAme “spardDante vA u devahUye” f॰ 7 । 85 । 2 । BAve kyap । 2 devAnAmAhvAne na॰ “te vA eta ftavaH । devAH pitaraH samo hEva vidvAndevAH pitaraH iti hvayatyAhAsya devA devahUyaM gacCantyA pitaraH pitfhUyamavanti hEnaM devA devahUye'vanti pitaraH pitfhUye ya evaM vidvAn devAH pitara iti hvayati” Sata॰ brA॰ 2 । 1 । 3 । 2 “ftvAdInAM devapitrAtmanAM dveDA viBAgamAha vasanta ityupakramya ya evamftUnAM devatvaM pitftvaM ca vidvAMstAnftUn devAH pitara iti hvayati vyavaharet asyAhvAtuH devahUyaM devahvAnaM prati devA AgacCanti AgatASca te svasambadDe karmaRi enamavanti” BA॰
m: देव—हूय n. invocation of the g˚, RV.; ŚBr.

v: na॰ 6 ta॰ । paSO “Apo devIH svadantu svAttaM citsaddevahaviH” yaju॰ 6 । 10
m: देव—हविस् n. oblation to the gods, VS.; ŚBr.

v: pu॰ devAya havyaM yasya । fziBede “saMvartto devahavyaSca vizvaksenaSca vIryavAn” BA॰ sa॰ 7 a॰ SakrasaByoktO ।
m: देव—हव्य m. N. of a Ṛṣi, ib.

v: na॰ hela--BAve lyuw 6 ta॰ lasya qaH । devAnAmavahelanarUpe aparADe “yaddevA devaheqanaM devAsaScakfmAvayam” yaju॰ 20 । 14
m: देव—हेडन or देव—हेळन, n. offence against the g˚, AV.; VS.; N. of AV. vi, 114; Kauś.
देव—हिंसक m. enemy of the gods, MW.
देव—हि˚तार्थाय ind. for the sake of the g˚, MBh. xiii, 13965.

v: tri॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 devAnAM hite 3 ta॰ । 2 devEH sTApite ca “nAnA hi vA devahitaM sadaskftam” yaju॰ 19 । 7
m: देव—हित (˚व-), mfn. arranged or appointed or settled by the g˚, RV.
देव—हित m. the good or welfare of the g˚
देव—हिति (˚व-), f. d˚ ordinance or arrangement, ib.

v: pu॰ trayodaSe manvantare yogeSvararUpasya hareraMSasya pitari । trayodaSamanUpakrame “devahotrasya tanaya upaharttA divaspateH । yogeSvaro hareraMSo vfhatyAM saMBavizyati” BAga॰ 8 । 13 । 14
m: देव—होत्र m. N. of the father of Yogeśvara (a partial incarnation [aṃśa] of Hari), BhP. viii, 13, 33.

v: pu॰ SrIparvatasTe tIrTaBede “SrIparvate mahAdevo devyA saha mahAdyutiH । nyavasat paramaprIto vrahmA ca tridaSEH saha । tatra devahrade snAtvA SuciH prayatamAnasaH । aSvameDamavApnoti parAM sidDiYca gacCati” BA॰ va॰ 85 a॰ ।
m: देव—ह्रद m. ‘the d˚ lake’, N. of a sacred bathing-place, MBh.
